title: Annotatio III §.VIII open: Even canonized — Transsubstantiation still on the Scholastic disputation-anvil
pass_a_gloss: §. VIII. Nor however, even once Transsubstantiation was thus canonized, was it placed beyond every danger of concussion and overthrow — rather it was still subjected to the anvil of licentious Scholastic Disputations by the standard-bearers themselves of the Scholastic Doctors, turning over and searching the genuine Mode of Conversion in every part and every which way.
pass_b_english: §.VIII: even after canonization, Transsubstantiation is not past concussion or overthrow.
Scholastic standard-bearers still hammer the genuine Conversion-mode on a licentious disputation-anvil — every part, every which way.
source_text: §. VIII. Neque tamen adhuc dum canonizata sic Transsubstantiatio, extra omne concussionis & eversionis periculum posita fuit, quin licentiosæ Scholasticarum Disceptationum incudi subjiceretur ab ipsis quoque Scholasticorum Doctorum Antesignanis, genuinum Conversionis modum in omnem partem & quaqua versum disquirendo versantibus.
